title: Fix Search Limit Handling for All Tools and Clients
description: Fix extractSearchFromInput to correctly handle limit/offset parameters from the Read tool and native.event.tool_input for Claude Code native events. All search ranges must respect the actual lines being read. Implement for all common tools: Read (offset+limit as line range), native Claude Code format (native.event.tool_input extraction). Also fix extractToolInputFromStdin to handle native.event.tool_input. Add tests for all cases.
summary: Added extractToolInputMapFromData helper that resolves tool_input from direct, native.event, and event wrapper formats. Updated extractSearchFromInput to use this helper and handle offset/limit parameters. Grep-style tools with pattern key correctly exclude their path from file range. Updated extractToolInputFromStdin and other extraction functions to use the helper. Added TestExtractToolInputMapFromData, TestExtractToolInputFromStdinNativeFormat, and 6 new subtests to TestExtractSearchFromInput.
